summary: GRI 303: Water and Effluents 2018 contains disclosures for reporting an organization's water-related impacts and how it manages them. It covers interactions with water as a shared resource, management of discharge-related impacts, and water withdrawal, discharge and consumption.

questions.text: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts of the organization on the economy, environment and people, including impacts on their human rights, in relation to water and effluents.
questions.hint: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts on the economy, environment, and people, including impacts on human rights (GRI 3-3-a).

questions.text: State whether the organization is involved with the negative impacts related to water and effluents through its own activities or as a result of its business relationships, and describe how.
questions.hint: Say whether the organization causes or contributes to the negative impacts through its activities, or whether they are linked to its operations, products or services through business relationships, and describe how (GRI 3-3-b).

questions.text: Describe the organization's policies or commitments regarding water and effluents.
questions.hint: Describe policies or commitments regarding the material topic (GRI 3-3-c).

questions.text: Describe the actions taken to manage water and effluents and the related impacts.
questions.hint: Include: i. how negative impacts are prevented or mitigated; ii. how actual negative impacts are addressed, including actions to provide for or cooperate in remediation; iii. how actual and potential positive impacts are managed (GRI 3-3-d).

questions.text: How does the organization track the effectiveness of its actions on water and effluents?
questions.hint: Report: i. information about the effectiveness of the actions; ii. the goals, targets and indicators used to evaluate progress; iii. lessons learned and how they have been integrated into policies and operational procedures (GRI 3-3-e).

questions.text: Describe how engagement with stakeholders has informed the actions taken on water and effluents and whether those actions have been effective.
questions.hint: Describe how stakeholder engagement has informed the actions taken (3-3-d) and how it has informed whether the actions have been effective (3-3-e) (GRI 3-3-f).

disclosures.title: Interactions with water as a shared resource

questions.text: Describe how the organization interacts with water and the water-related impacts it has caused, contributed to, or that are linked to it.
questions.hint: Include how and where water is withdrawn, consumed and discharged, and impacts caused or contributed to, or directly linked to operations, products or services by business relationships (e.g. impacts caused by runoff).

questions.text: Describe the approach used to identify water-related impacts.
questions.hint: Include the scope of assessments, their timeframe, and any tools or methodologies used.

questions.text: Describe how water-related impacts are addressed.
questions.hint: Include how the organization works with stakeholders to steward water as a shared resource, and how it engages with suppliers or customers with significant water-related impacts.

questions.text: Explain the process for setting water-related goals and targets.
questions.hint: Goals and targets that are part of the approach to managing water and effluents, and how they relate to public policy and the local context of each area with water stress.

questions.text: Describe any minimum standards set for the quality of effluent discharge and how they were determined.
questions.hint: Include: i. how standards were determined for facilities in locations with no local discharge requirements; ii. any internally developed water quality standards or guidelines; iii. any sector-specific standards considered; iv. whether the profile of the receiving waterbody was considered.

questions.text: What is the total water withdrawal from all areas in megaliters, by source?
questions.hint: Break down by, if applicable: i. surface water; ii. groundwater; iii. seawater; iv. produced water; v. third-party water.

questions.text: What is the total water withdrawal from all areas with water stress in megaliters, by source?
questions.hint: Break down by, if applicable: i. surface water; ii. groundwater; iii. seawater; iv. produced water; v. third-party water, and a breakdown of this total by sources i-iv.

parts.label: Total withdrawal from areas with water stress

questions.text: What is the breakdown of water withdrawal from each source in 303-3-a and 303-3-b by freshwater and other water?
questions.hint: In megaliters: i. freshwater (<=1,000 mg/L Total Dissolved Solids); ii. other water (>1,000 mg/L TDS).

questions.text: What contextual information is needed to understand how the water withdrawal data were compiled?
questions.hint: Such as any standards, methodologies, and assumptions used.

questions.text: What is the total water discharge to all areas in megaliters, by destination?
questions.hint: Break down by, if applicable: i. surface water; ii. groundwater; iii. seawater; iv. third-party water, and the volume sent for use to other organizations, if applicable.

questions.text: What is the breakdown of total water discharge to all areas by freshwater and other water?
questions.hint: In megaliters: i. freshwater (<=1,000 mg/L TDS); ii. other water (>1,000 mg/L TDS).

questions.text: What is the total water discharge to all areas with water stress, by freshwater and other water?
questions.hint: In megaliters: i. freshwater (<=1,000 mg/L TDS); ii. other water (>1,000 mg/L TDS).

questions.text: For which priority substances of concern are discharges treated?
questions.hint: Include: i. how they were defined and any international standard, authoritative list or criteria used; ii. the approach for setting discharge limits; iii. number of incidents of non-compliance with discharge limits.

questions.text: What contextual information is needed to understand how the water discharge data were compiled?
questions.hint: Such as any standards, methodologies, and assumptions used.

questions.text: What is the total water consumption from all areas in megaliters?
questions.hint: Total water consumption from all areas in megaliters.

questions.text: What is the total water consumption from all areas with water stress in megaliters?
questions.hint: Total water consumption from all areas with water stress in megaliters.

questions.text: What is the change in water storage in megaliters?
questions.hint: Report if water storage has been identified as having a significant water-related impact.

questions.text: What contextual information is needed to understand how the water consumption data were compiled?
questions.hint: Such as standards, methodologies and assumptions, including whether information is calculated, estimated, modeled or from direct measurements, and the approach taken, such as any sector-specific factors.
